<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-19. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Stream download:** Playlist and album headers show how many tracks are ready. **Resume** continues an interrupted download without fetching saved tracks again, and one failing track no longer stops the rest of the list.
- **Stream download:** Downloads keep running after you leave Music or turn the screen off. A playlist or album shows one progress notification and one summary instead of a notification per track.
- **Stream download:** Interrupted playlists and albums resume on their own while Music is open on unmetered Wi-Fi. A download waits up to five minutes for a lost connection before it pauses. Music does not wake itself to continue: open the app, or tap **Resume**, which works on any connection.

Update to **RVX Patches v1.43.0** in Morphe Manager and repatch your app to get these changes.
